name: HackTool - SharpLDAPmonitor Execution
description: Detects execution of the SharpLDAPmonitor. Which can monitor the creation, deletion and changes to LDAP objects.
author: GAI_CTI
query: (process.executable:*\\SharpLDAPmonitor.exe OR process.pe.original_file_name:SharpLDAPmonitor.exe) OR (process.command_line:*\/user\:* AND process.command_line:*\/pass\:* AND process.command_line:*\/dcip\:*)
